description.narrative:
CCC is a membership organization, working on seven thematic areas which are supporting its overall objectives. The project tends toaddress challenges faced by women/young girl entrepreneurs, particularly in the fields of banana and rubber plantation, and some relevant CSOs so that they could enhance their capacity to go more sustained and aligned with relevant national policies/system. The Cooperation Committee for Cambodia (CCC) who is the largest membership based organization for NGOs in Cambodia would respond to the needs of these particular groups by providing a number of capacity development, conducing some research to inform advocacy actions, and promoting space for them to dialogues with stakeholders to address relevant challenges. CCC will run this project alongside with its single Governance Hub Program (GHP 2017-2021) which contains some relevant interventions on capacity development on governance and sustainability, advocacy and dialogue for enabling environment, inclusive partnership for common development agenda, local resource mobilization, and effective communication for CSOs in Cambodia.
Within this project CCC focuses on the following: 1. The capacity development package that covers areas related to good governance, resource mobilization, resiliency building etc. 2. Strengtheningthe capacity of Community based Organizations (CBOs) particularly in terms of good governance, financial sustainability and resiliency. The CBOs target beneficiaries of CCC include such types of small scale producer group and grass root based organization. 3. Themulti-stakeholder partnership among development stakeholders in Cambodia and that includes different dialogue platforms between CSOs and the government, CSOs and private sector, CSO and DPs that could promote mutual understanding and enhance enabling environment for the civil society sector. 4. Advocacy on policy and legal framework affecting CSOs and development stakeholders such as on the Law on Association and Non-Governmental Organizations (LANGO), Taxation Law, Labour Law, National Strategic Development Plan (NSDPs),Development Cooperation and Partnership Strategy (DCPS), Cambodian Sustainable Development Goals (CSDGs) etc. Within these, some aspects related to the fiscal requirements and preferential systems for the small and medium enterprises are also covered.

participating-org.narrative: The Cooperation Coomiitee for Cambodia (CCC) was established in 1990 as an association of Civil Society Organisations in Cambodia. It is a leading network strengthening the cooperation, professionalism, accountability, governance and effectiveness of itsmembers and representing the sector to the government and donors. It aims to contribute to a cohesive, accountable and transparent NGO sector, contributing more effectively to the development of Cambodia.
